reviewed: Complete driver, workflow and execution manifest; all original invoked native/Swift Make and generate scripts; exact imported Commands and check_file implementations.
Original Heart and SDK checkouts are independently copied for baseline/candidate; source inventories compare equal before the two explicit proto overlays.

Exact hashed tool archives/member executables are verified before execution. Mutable PATH updates reach Commands by the same retained env object. Original makefiles prepend each lane own Go plugin deps directory.
Inherited SHELLOPTS plus explicit Bash errexit/pipefail stop original semicolon/pipeline failures; commands retain raw stdout/stderr, owned groups and finite absolute remaining budgets.
Fresh required output families replace only disposable-copy outputs; baseline versus tracked drift is retained separately from candidate versus same-toolchain baseline.

Generated sources are retained before compilation and on failure; scope explicitly limits Go build to pb/pb-service and Swift typecheck to generated protocol models against genuine pinned SwiftProtobuf.
Only actually created owned work is removed after all child groups drain; failure partials remain explicitly unqualified. Signals enter existing owned-group cleanup.
remaining_gates: Actual original generator execution may reveal tool/recipe/typecheck failures; this review does not predict PASS.
Generated deltas and baseline drift require exact output review before integration.
Middleware endpoint, Swift Invocation/permission/drain source, full iOS SDK and live schema runtime are not compiled or executed by this gate.
